units.title: Basic Circuits Elements And Energy Sources
topics: 1.1. Electric circuit terminology: Electric Current, Potential Difference, Electric power and Energy
1.2. Voltage Drop and Current through: Resister, Capacitor and Inductor
1.3. Sources of electrical energy: dependant and independent; Series and parallel connected sources, Source transformation
1.5. Kirchhoff’s laws: Kirchhoff’s current law, Kirchhoff’s voltage law
uos: 1.a. Differentiate between, electric Current, Potential Difference, Electric Power and Energy
1.b. Calculate voltage and current in R, L and C circuits
1.c. Calculate equivalent source from series and parallel connected energy sources
1.d. Solve various electrical networks applying Ohm’s Law, Kirchhoff’s laws, Divider Rules etc.
1.e. Transform Delta-Wye and Wye – Delta connections

units.title: Alternating Current Circuits
topics: 2.1. Alternating Current: average value, RMS value and form factor.
2.2. A.C. Voltage applied to: resister, inductor, capacitor, RL, RC and RLC series circuits.
2.3. Series and parallel resonance, Quality factor, Bandwidth
2.4. Alternating current and Voltages: Polar form, Rectangular form and Vector representation.
uos: 2.a. Calculate average value, RMS value and form factor of AC circuits
2.b. Interpret the response of R, L, C; RL, RC and RLC series circuits to AC supply.
2.c. Explain series and parallel resonance with its quality factor and bandwidth.
2.d. Solve problems to Convert AC voltage and current to polar, rectangular and vector form.

units.title: Network Analysis
uos: 3.a. Analyse networks using mesh and nodal analysis
3.b. Apply source transformation in relevant applications

units.title: Network Theorems And Coupled Circuits
topics: 4.1. Network Theorems: Thevenin’s, Norton’s, Superposition, Maximum power transfer, Millman’s, Reciprocity Tellegen’s and Compensation Theorems.
4.2. Mutually coupled circuits- series and parallel connection, Conductively coupled equivalent circuits
4.3. Dot convention UNIT – V 5a. Explain the need for two port network

5.1. Network parameter: two port; Relationship between parameters Electrical Network and Circuits Course code: 3342403 GTU/NITTTR/Bhopal/13-14 Gujarat State 3 Unit Major Learning Outcomes (in cognitive domain) Topics and Sub-topics Two Port Network
uos: 4.a. State the salient features of the various network theorems
4.b. Apply various network theorems to analyse various types of DC circuits
4.c. Describe the features of mutually coupled series and parallel circuits
5.a. Explain the working of conductively coupled equivalent circuits
4.d. State the need for dot convention
5.b. Explain the relationship between network parameters
5.c. Describe series and cascade interconnection of two port network.
